description: Measured visible-surface pigment on the turned lower body, with smooth inferred continuation. Upper head/button pixels, all geometry, relief, lamps and the 54-degree camera are preserved.
residual_limitation: Pigment inversion is approximate under inferred lights. Actual visibility replaces the old projection mask; retained existing highlight pigment and inferred hidden wood can still contain illumination and discontinuities. No exact intrinsic-albedo claim.
